summary.name: Jasper
summary.one_liner: Jasper is an enterprise AI platform for marketing teams that uses brand-aware agents, workflows and content pipelines to plan, create, localize and measure campaigns.
use_cases: Creating on-brand campaign content across channels
Improving brand visibility in AI search answers
Localizing campaigns for regions and audiences in 27 languages
Generating on-brand product images at scale
Automating email, social and SEO content workflows
Connecting performance data back into marketing workflows
summary.what_it_does: Jasper is positioned as an AI operating system for enterprise marketing teams, combining forward-deployed experts, a brand context layer (Jasper IQ), governance controls and marketing-specific agents. The page says its agents run end-to-end workflows for tasks such as SEO and GEO content, campaign execution, email, social media, personalization and research, and that teams can build custom agents with AI Studio. It describes Image Pipelines for on-brand product imagery and Image APIs for background removal, upscaling and similar edits, plus support for uploading audio and video to a Knowledge Base. It also mentions an MCP server so brand context can be used in other AI tools, and integrations for connecting performance data back into Jasper. The page states it supports 27 languages for localization.
notable: Jasper IQ stores brand voice, style guides, audience profiles and product knowledge and applies them to every output
Purpose-built marketing agents plus AI Studio for custom agents
Image Pipelines claim up to 10x faster and up to 50% lower cost than traditional image production
MCP server lets brand context travel into other AI tools
caveats: Aimed at enterprise marketing teams; the page does not list individual plan prices
Performance claims (e.g., 342% ROI, 10x faster images) come from vendor-cited Forrester and marketing material, not independently verified here
Requires working with Jasper experts to scope and build workflows, per the page's onboarding description
